description: Fix text typed with the wrong keyboard layout between US English (QWERTY) and Arabic (101): "hgsghl ugd;l" becomes the Arabic greeting, and Arabic gibberish typed on English keys becomes "hello". Direction "auto" detects it; in mixed text only the words that look mistyped are converted (using small English/Arabic letter-pair models), so words that are already right stay as they are. Handles the shift layer (harakat, hamza forms), lam-alef keys and Caps Lock (all-caps Latin input is treated as lowercase). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/layout-fixer/

capsLock.description: Caps Lock was on: treat capital Latin letters as lowercase (detected automatically when all letters are capitals).

direction.description: "auto" (default) detects; "ar" = typed on English keys, convert to Arabic; "en" = typed on Arabic keys, convert to English.

path.description: Or: a path to a UTF-8 text file.

name: text_layout_fix
title: Keyboard layout fixer (EN ⇄ AR)
